goals.name: Attainment of the Aquatic Life Designated Use
Mitigate increased sedimentation from newly converted pastures
Bring about behavior changes and use of best management practices

implementation.name: Project management, implementation, coordination and plan revision
Memorandum of agreement with MACD to implement the project
Target implementation on recently converted land, then other pasture areas
Develop, execute and implement a Subgrant Agreement
Facilitate meetings, media and social media promotion, and coordinate activities
Inform landowners and operators and secure commitments from priority area landowners
Determine priority areas through GIS and site surveys; install BMPs to NRCS guidelines
Complete and implement a plan to monitor baseline water quality and track changes
Submit blank copies of standard maintenance agreements to MDEQ
Conduct inspections of BMPs during construction
Collect GPS coordinates of installed BMPs into GIS format
Collect photo documentation before, during and after installation
Report pollutant load reduction, acreage affected, site conditions and GIS data
Coordinate with MDEQ, NRCS, MSWCC, USGS, MACD and the SWCD to determine priority areas
Establish Watershed Implementation Team
Initiate watershed monitoring
Meet with landowners and cooperators to secure commitments to install BMPs
Establish routine meeting schedule for WIT to support WBP revision
Implement BMPs
Coordinate with landowners to inspect BMPs installed using Section 319 funds
Begin monitoring to collect data on post-BMP water quality
Finalize education and outreach plan
Finalize revised WBP
Conduct a Stressor Analysis if data show little or no positive change

M-BISQ attainment threshold for the East bioregion
Biological community data and in-stream habitat surveys

Post-BMP monitoring downstream of BMP activity
